# Vozen

> Vozen builds focused tools for Discord communities, including Vozen TTS and Vozen Helper.

## Public products

- [Vozen TTS](https://vozen.org/tts/): voice and reading tools for Discord channels.
- [Vozen Helper](https://vozen.org/helper/): moderation, community, support and server-operation tools.
- [Vozen Helper documentation](https://vozen.org/docs/helper/): public setup and troubleshooting guides.
- [TTS without a microphone](https://vozen.org/guides/discord-without-a-mic/): a practical typed-to-voice Discord guide.
- [Vozen Helper first modules](https://vozen.org/guides/helper-moderation-tickets-roles/): moderation, tickets and role-panel setup.

## Account and support

- [Account](https://vozen.org/account/): manage signed-in product access.
- [Support server](https://discord.gg/4kYw2WUbNN): community support and product help.
- [Privacy policy](https://vozen.org/privacy.html)
- [Terms of service](https://vozen.org/terms.html)

Vozen does not publish private account, guild, user or billing data in this file.
